notes: Stage targets are starting points compiled from general hydroponic maize guidance.
The biology team must verify/adjust these, then the ML optimizer refines them from logged data.
dataset_envelope comes from analysis/analyze_dataset.py (5th-95th percentile of the Kaggle maize rows).

stages.name: germination
stages.spectrum: none - seeds germinate in the dark
stages.biology: Seed imbibes water; radicle then coleoptile emerge. Keep warm and moist, plain water or very dilute solution.

stages.name: seedling
stages.biology: V1-V4 leaf stages. Roots establishing; low nutrient demand, sensitive to salt burn.

stages.name: vegetative
stages.biology: V5-VT. Rapid biomass gain, high nitrogen demand, water uptake rises sharply.

stages.name: reproductive
stages.biology: VT/R1 tasseling and silking. Heat >35 C or very high humidity hurts pollen; peak water demand.

stages.name: grain_fill
stages.biology: R2-R6 kernel fill to maturity. Potassium and phosphorus demand high; water uptake tapers.
